svg.title: Overview of dependable LLM centered agentic systems
svg.desc: A two panel systems overview inspired by academic survey figures. The left panel describes the agentic core through state, reasoning, memory, and coordination. The right panel describes the assurance scaffold through permission, execution, verification, recovery, and a persistent case. Equations, concise prose, diagrams, and application scenes are combined.
svg.text: A MODEL INSIDE A CONTROLLED SYSTEM
proposal → authorization → execution → verification → state update
model • persistent state • tools • policy • verifier
â(t) = πθ(· | s(t)), s(t) = (g, e, m, p, b)
Key change: proposal → authorized, verified effect
A Systems Survey: From evidence and state to authorized, verified effects
